title: Observable Serverless API
summary: Deploy a small serverless API, generate synthetic success and failure traffic, investigate telemetry, create an alert, collect evidence, and clean up safely.
objectives: Provision a minimal observable serverless workload with infrastructure as code.
Generate successful, failed, and intentionally slow requests.
Use logs and traces to identify the synthetic incident's cause.
Configure and verify an operational alert.
Export sanitized evidence before the temporary environment expires.
Explain how identity, networking, deployment, and monitoring should change in production.

sandbox_notes: Implemented and tested offline; no live sandbox verification is claimed.
The implementation must accept an existing resource group.
Managed identity cannot be required in the Pluralsight Azure sandbox.
Any connection string used for sandbox execution must be short-lived, excluded from Git, and labeled as a sandbox compromise.
production_extensions: Use managed identity instead of application credentials or storage keys.
Add private endpoints, private DNS, and controlled egress where appropriate.
Use workload identity federation for deployment automation.
Add release slots or an equivalent safe deployment strategy.
Define SLOs, actionable alert routing, retention, and access controls.

sandbox_notes: Future implementation; requirements have not been verified through a complete run.
production_extensions: Use least-privilege roles, private connectivity, structured release controls, and production retention policies.
